question: In January 2022, scientists from IIT Kharagpur revealed a portable, user-friendly and non-invasive device for detecting __ __ cancer in resource-constrained clinical settings.
solution:
The correct answer is __**oral**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In January 2022, scientists from IIT Kharagpur revealed a portable, user-friendly, and non-invasive device for detecting oral cancer in resource-constrained clinical settings
 
• The Blood Perfusion Imager (BPI) is a portable and low-cost device designed to aid in the early detection of cancerous and non-cancerous traits in tissues.44
 
• Features:
 
• Portable and Handheld: Easy to use and suitable for resource-constrained settings.
 
• Low-Cost: Makes it affordable for widespread use, especially in underdeveloped areas.
 
• Combines a miniature far-infrared (FIR) camera, humidity sensor, and software engine to detect blood flow variations in tissues.
 
• Purpose:
 
• The device’s primary purpose is to classify tissues as normal, benign, or malignant by analyzing blood perfusion patterns.
 
• How It Works:
 
• The BPI estimates blood flow variations in tissue and evaluates its response to determine the likelihood of cancer. It can differentiate between healthy, benign, and cancerous tissues based on these variations.
 
• Benefits:
 
• It can save millions of lives by enabling early diagnosis of cancer through non-invasive methods.
 
• It helps strengthen doctors’ confidence in making accurate diagnoses, potentially leading to faster treatments and better outcomes for patients.
